handoff: Review approve: all 10 criteria of use: shared files traced to asserting tests; strict workflow schema unchanged, no-use workflows load byte for byte; suite and typecheck green. One minor note (use names read before pattern check).

findings.title: use: names are read from disk before the SharedName pattern is checked
findings.detail:
loadFile pre-reads join(workflowsDir, 'shared', `${n}.yaml`) for every raw string sharedFilesUsed returns (packages/store/src/shared-workflow.ts:47-51), before flattenWorkflowText runs check(UseStep) (line 75). A step `use: ../../x` makes the loader read a .yaml outside shared/. The content is never used or shown, since the UseStep check then refuses the step, so this is hardening only, in a sensitive path (packages/store/).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Filter sharedFilesUsed to names matching SharedName (or check the pattern before reading).
